text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She was chosen!
Narita Brian is the Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Umamusume of the Year?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian-san, perfect timing!
Please let me explain right away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume of the Year is one of the most prestigious titles
awarded to the most highly acclaimed Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The awards ceremony will be held at a later date,
so please look over the attendance materials.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, because this ceremony will surely mark
a major milestone for Narita Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, do I really have to go?
choice_data_list: You can still sit this one out if you want, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I detest things like status and positions.
They only invite unnecessary trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just want to focus.
On running, and nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However, it seems powerhouse Umamusume who won awards in the past will also be attending the ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing their presence and mindsets firsthand
should positively impact our running. Besides—
choice_data_list: One's position can also forge the resolve to be strong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...So both choices are hard to give up.
Understood, in that case..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Making me stronger is your job.
I'll leave it to you to steer the ship."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have made my choice.
I will not complain, so take the path that is necessary for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is a crucial decision that will shape her future.
Does she desire to clash with battle-hardened veterans,
or does she not? The choice to be made here is—
choice_data_list: Hoping to face the best of the best, select 'Attend'
We're not at that stage yet, so "Will not attend."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, understood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then let us depart... having earned our place.
Unto the stage where powerhouse contenders clash.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I contacted them to let them know
Narita Brian would be attending—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I am still nothing more than a mere competitor.
It is too early for me to climb those stairs.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She might not even understand
what true strength is yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I contacted them to let them know
Narita Brian would be absent—
